name: appointment_book
description: Protected, two-step. Book, or move, the in-person step a granted application needs (passport biometrics at the Konza Passport Desk), after the fee is paid: any working day within the next 10 working days, morning (8 to 12) or afternoon (2 to 5). The first call only prepares and tells you the date: use it to answer 'which day'. Booking again with another day or window moves an existing appointment, until the day before it. Only the holder attends.

application_id.description: application_id from application_submit on this call. Leave it out on a later call: the caller's newest granted application in the open service is used.

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given

on_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a working day the caller asked for. Leave out for the next working day.
